xna-type.name: MaterialContent
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for maintaining a collection of named texture references.
xna-type.remarks: In addition to texture references, opaque data values are stored in the OpaqueData property of the base class.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of MaterialContent.

property.name: Textures
property.summary: Gets the texture collection of the material.
property.value: Collection of textures used by the material.

method.name: GetReferenceTypeProperty
method.summary: Gets a reference type from the OpaqueDataDictionary collection.

overload.summary: Gets a reference type from the OpaqueDataDictionary collection.

parameters.parameter: Key of the property being retrieved.

overload.returns: Type of the related opaque data.

method.name: GetTexture
method.summary: Gets a value from the Textures collection.

overload.summary: Gets a value from the Textures collection.

parameters.parameter: Key of the texture being retrieved.

overload.returns: Reference to a texture from the collection.

method.name: GetValueTypeProperty
method.summary: Gets a value type from the OpaqueDataDictionary collection.

overload.summary: Gets a value type from the OpaqueDataDictionary collection.

parameters.parameter: Key of the value type being retrieved.

overload.returns: Index of the value type beng retrieved.

method.name: SetProperty
method.summary: Sets a value in the contained OpaqueDataDictionary object.

overload.summary: Sets a value in the contained OpaqueDataDictionary object.
overload.syntax: protected void SetProperty<T> ( string key, T value )

type-parameters.type-parameter: Type of the element being set.

parameters.parameter: Name of the key being modified.

method.name: SetTexture
method.summary: Sets a value in the contained TextureReferenceDictionary object.

overload.summary: Sets a value in the contained TextureReferenceDictionary object.
overload.syntax: protected void SetTexture ( string key, ExternalReference<TextureContent> value )

parameters.parameter: Name of the key being modified.
